title: Integrative Transcriptomic and In Silico Perturbation Analysis Identifies Diagnostic Biomarkers in Thyroid Cancer.
snippet: Thyroid cancer is a common endocrine malignancy, yet many bioinformatics studies focus on correlation-based biomarker identification without evaluating the predicted functional roles of candidate genes in malignant cellular states. title: Optimized Tissue Microarray for In Situ Characterization of Central Nervous System Tumors Using a Spatial Transcriptomics Platform.
